# cursor_team_members (Data Source)

Reads Admin API team members with the provider team_api_key. role is member or owner. There is no admin value. Use a lifecycle precondition, not a check block, to fail the plan when membership does not match the approved list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cursor_team_members" "current" {}

locals {
  # Removed members stay in the list, so filter them out before using the ids.
  active_member_ids_by_email = {
    for member in data.cursor_team_members.current.members :
    lower(member.email) => member.id if !member.is_removed
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) team.
- `members` (Attributes List) Team members, including removed members, sorted by email and then id. Empty when the team has no members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Member email.
- `id` (String) Member id.
- `is_removed` (Boolean) True for a member who was removed from the team. Removed members stay in the list.
- `name` (String) Member display name.
- `role` (String) member or owner.
